name: IsCorrectDateTimeFormatNode
label: Validate DateTime Format
description: Checks if the input string matches the specified date and time format.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: InputDateTime
fields.label: DateTime String
fields.description: The date and time string to validate.

fields.name: DateTimeFormat
fields.label: Expected Format
fields.description: The expected format pattern to validate against (e.g., yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss).

fields.name: IsValid
fields.label: Is Format Valid
fields.description: Returns true if the input matches the expected format; otherwise, false.
